sloka: सकृदेव समिद्धस्य विधूमस्य महार्चिषः।बभूवुस्तानि लिङ्गानि विजयं दर्शयन्ति च ।। ६.८०.९ ।।
transliteration: sakṛdeva samiddhasya vidhūmasya mahārciṣaḥ।babhūvustāni liṅgāni vijayaṁ darśayanti ca ।। 6.80.9 ।।

translations.english: By that action of fire sacrifice, the mighty flames and the smoke that appeared from the mighty smokeless fire signifying victory appeared.
